extension.description: Starts theatre-os-moonlight.service via systemctl. The unit's Conflicts=kodi-gbm.service stops Kodi (releasing DRM master); ExecStopPost= brings Kodi back when moonlight exits. The kodi user is allowed to invoke this one unit without auth via /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/10-theatre-os-moonlight.rules. See theatre-os README → Display ownership: stop-and-start handoff.
